turns.assessment: The impairment begins before the first amplifier on S10→S02: amp0 input and every downstream amplifier input/output fall together by about 5.5 dB, while pump currents are unchanged. Multiple channels at the S02 OCM show the same loss, excluding a channel-specific WSS fault, and the partial sustained loss excludes a pulled connector or pump failure. Recent maintenance at S10 further supports contamination of the patch between the S10 ROADM degree and booster.

proposals.rationale: A dirty S10 OMS-input connector would reduce all channels entering the S10→S02 booster. This exactly matches the equal approximately 5.5 dB drop already present at amp0 input and propagated through all amplifiers and the S02 channel monitor, with stable pump currents. S10 also had recent maintenance.
